abstract_summary: Protecting quantum coherence is a central theme of modern quantum technologies. Carefully designed control pulses can extend coherence by suppressing disorder and unwanted interactions. However, designing robust pulse sequences remains challenging in interacting multi-level systems, where multiple independent error...

evidence.excerpt:
RESEARCH AGENT
Powered by GPT-6-Astra and Sorol, QORA connects
human scientists, a theoretical agent, Theo, and an ex-
perimental agent, Dex, in a closed feedback loop for quan-
tum control discovery (Fig. 1). Human scientists define
the scientific goals and assign tasks to Theo, while re-
viewing experimental reports from Dex as needed. Theo
coordinates five specialized sub-agents that propose, re-
view, simulate, classify and assemble control sequences.
Drawing on a knowledge base compiled from the litera-
ture on dynamical decoupling and Hamiltonian engineer-
ing, Theo refines candidate sequences in response to sim-
ulation results. Dex uses the GPT API to interact with
instrument-control software, implementing the selected
sequences, acquiring measurements and calibrating the
apparatus as needed. The resulting data return to Theo
to guide further sequence design.

Theo organizes sequence design into
block discovery and composition (Fig. 1), drawing on the
hierarchical construction from literature [26]. The design
strategy reflects the separation of energy scales in our NV
ensemble, where microwave driving error and local dis-
order are much stronger than dipolar couplings. Theo
therefore searches for 18-pulse blocks that suppress these
noise channels, then combines transformed versions of a
selected block into a longer cycle to reduce dipolar inter-
actions. A complete cycle contains seven 18-pulse blocks,
giving 126 pulses in total. Each pulse comprises two si-
multaneous microwave tones addressing the two transi-
tions between the three spin-1 sublevels, (|0⟩ ↔ |+ 1⟩)
and (|0⟩ ↔ | −1⟩), with each tone's phase independently
selected from a (π/4) grid. Cyclic shifts and tone-specific
phase offsets provide the degrees of freedom for

diamond containing NV centers with density 1.2 ppm.
Each NV center hosts a spin-1 ground state, with three
sublevels,|0⟩and|±1⟩, forming a natural qutrit Hilbert

|±1⟩states are separated from|0⟩by a zero-field split-
ting of ∆≈2π×2.87 GHz, while an external magnetic
field ofB 0 = 123 G aligned with one of the four NV
crystallographic orientations lifts the|±1⟩degeneracy

QORA discovers AID-RODs, a family of dynamical
decoupling sequences with cycle durations comparable
to DROID-C3PO. Each cycle contains seven 18-pulse
blocks, and each block consists of three identical copies
of a six-pulse unit, giving 126 pulses per cycle. These de-
sign features improve coherence preservation: AID-ROD-
1 achievesT 2 = 18.6±0.7µs, compared with 9.8±1.1µs
for DROID-C3PO (Fig. 2d). Each block also implements
an approximate identity propagator, allowing coherence
to be sampled at block boundaries rather than only after
a complete cycle. This finer sampling is illustrated in the
right inset of Figure 2d. A second experimentally tested
sequence, AID-ROD-2, achieves a comparable coherence
time,T 2 = 19.3±1.0µs (upper-left inset of Fig. 2d).

OUTLOOK
Our results demonstrate how a multi-agent AI system
combining theoretical reasoning with automated experi-
mentation can discover new quantum control protocols.
Human interpretation connects their improved perfor-
mance to the underlying error-suppression mechanisms,
illustrating how collaboration between AI agents and hu-
man researchers can generate new physical insight.
Looking forward, our work opens the door to a few
intriguing directions. First, a natural extension is to ap-
ply this approach to higher-dimensional quantum sys-
tems beyond spin-1, such as atomic, trapped-ion and
superconducting qudits

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The headline T2 gain is established by physical laboratory measurements on the NV ensemble, not by the simulation signal used to select sequences.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Physical optical fluorescence measurements of spin coherence decay on a diamond NV ensemble, including T2 values and robustness sweeps.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Simulated ensemble-averaged differential contrast C(t) across twelve initial states via exact diagonalization, plus iterative experimental calibration and decay profiles.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported coherence improvements and robustness claims align well with the physical measurements and are corroborated by an average Hamiltonian theory analysis explaining why the 18-pulse blocks suppress leading linear/quadratic onsite disorder and drive amplitude errors [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0025, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0026].
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation combines physical experiment on a 1.2 ppm diamond NV ensemble with baseline comparisons against the prior state of the art (DROID-C3PO), measuring spin coherence time T2 increases from 9.8 us to 18.6 us, as well as testing robustness against pulse-spacing variations and drive-amplitude Rabi errors [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0015, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0022].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline performance gains were independently verified via laboratory optical readout of spin coherence decay on an actual diamond NV ensemble and theoretical average Hamiltonian derivation [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0026].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Physical laboratory measurement of spin coherence decay times (T2) via optical fluorescence differential contrast across varied pulse spacings, drive-amplitude errors, and spin-1/2 subspace controls [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0019, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0022, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0027].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Simulated ensemble-averaged differential contrast C(t) across 12 initial states calculated via exact diagonalization, alongside iterative experimental drift calibration and decay profiles [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0012, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0013, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0014].

primary.limitations: The manuscript notes that physical interpretation of the discovered sequence was conducted post-hoc by human researchers rather than by the AI itself, and that validation is currently restricted to spin-1 NV ensembles under specific microwave drive regimes [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0028, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0031].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing the split between the theoretical agent (Theo) and experimental control agent (Dex), the exact 18-pulse block structure and composition constraints, exact diagonalization screening across 12 target spin states, and the physical NV Hamiltonian modeling [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0010, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0011, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0012, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0013, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0018].
primary.quality_rationale: The work presents a clear, well-scoped experimental contribution demonstrating the autonomous discovery and physical validation of high-performing quantum control sequences, supported by rigorous experimental baselines, error sweeps, and analytical verification.
primary.scoped_contribution: The manuscript introduces QORA, an LLM-assisted multi-agent framework integrating theoretical proposal/simulation with automated experimental calibration, which discovered the AID-ROD family of dynamical decoupling pulse sequences for dense spin-1 nitrogen-vacancy (NV) center ensembles [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0007, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0010, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0021].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The work presents a clear, well-scoped experimental contribution demonstrating the autonomous discovery and physical validation of high-performing quantum control sequences, supported by rigorous experimental baselines, error sweeps, and analytical verification.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The manuscript notes that physical interpretation of the discovered sequence was conducted post-hoc by human researchers rather than by the AI itself, and that validation is currently restricted to spin-1 NV ensembles under specific microwave drive regimes [E6dd1605abad08d63-B0028, E6dd1605abad08d63-B0031].
